name: Penvita
tagline: A resume that lets your work lead.
description: Penvita is a resume and CV builder for your phone that syncs with the Penvita website. Write your resume once with a guided editor, choose from 18 templates, and export a PDF that looks exactly as designed. It is free to start, and it suits anyone preparing a professional resume or CV.
features: Guided step-by-step editor with automatic saving
Import an existing resume from a PDF or DOCX file
Download your resume as a PDF and share it from your phone
Add a headshot from your camera or photo library, resized automatically
Customize accent colour, font, spacing, photo shape, ATS mode and A4 or US Letter page size
Reorder or hide resume sections, with bold, italic and bullet formatting
One account for the app and the website, so your resumes stay in sync

howItWorks.title: Create your account
howItWorks.text: Sign up with your name, email and password, then start a resume from scratch, from a sample, or by importing a PDF or DOCX.

howItWorks.title: Build and style it
howItWorks.text: Follow the guided steps to add your details, pick one of 18 templates, and adjust colours, fonts and layout. Changes save automatically.

howItWorks.title: Download and share
howItWorks.text: Preview your resume, export it as a PDF, and send or save it with your phone's share sheet. Finish on the website any time.
